info.title: Screener - Equities
info.description:
## Overview

The Screener API for equities is designed to support advanced, criteria-based screening. It enables you to retrieve highly-tailored datasets quickly and efficiently.


## Request Limits

Maximum of **100 data points** per request.


## Authentication

Retrieve tokens required to authorize calls to the API. See [documentation](https://developer.morningstar.com/direct-web-services/documentation/api-utilities/authentication-api/overview).

post.summary: Query equity investments and return selected data points.

get.description: Returns the list of equity data points supported for screener queries. Metadata returned for each entry includes the operators supported.

Bearer.description: Obtain a token via the Authentication API's `POST /token/oauth` endpoint. Tokens are valid for 60 minutes and reusable across requests.

RequestEquitiesScreener.title: RequestEquitiesScreener
RequestEquitiesScreener.description: Screener request body. All fields are optional, however either `scope` or `query` must be provided.

scope.description:
Defines the starting universe of investments. For equities, the scoping data point is `shareClassInformation.exchangeCode`. 
Compound and nested compound queries are supported. Each branch of the query must contain the scoping data point.

sort.description:
Specifies one or more data points to sort results by. If multiple values are provided, they are applied in the order listed in the array (the first value is the primary sort key, the second value is the secondary key, and so on).
Data points specified must correspond to a value passed in the `dataPoints` array.
If not provided, results will be sorted by `investmentIdentfiers.performanceId`.

languageId.description: Specifies the language code used to filter language-dependent results.

currencyId.description: Specifies the currency code used to filter currency-dependent results. Accepts ISO 4217 currency codes.

ResponseEquitiesScreener.title: ResponseEquitiesScreener
ResponseEquitiesScreener.description: Screener response including results and metadata.

ResponseDataPoints.title: ResponseDataPoints
ResponseDataPoints.description: Data points and operators supported for equities screening.

InputQueryOptions.title: InputQueryOptions
InputQueryOptions.description:
Filters investments using `field:value` conditions or compound logic. For example:
* Basic query - "equals": `{ "shareClassInformation.symbol": "MSES" }`
* Basic query - "in": `{ "shareClassInformation.symbol": ["MSES", "CA40"] }`
* Basic query - "range": `{ "marketCapital.asOfDate": { "gt": "2020-01-01", "lt": "2024-01-01" } }`
* Compound query: `{ "and": [ { "field1": "value1" }, { "field2": "value2" } ] }`
* Nested compound query: `{ "or": [ { "and": [ ... ] }, { "field": "value" } ] }`

and.description: All conditions must match (logical AND). Each element is an `InputQueryOptions` object and may itself contain nested `and`, `or`, or `not` logic.

or.description: At least one condition must match (logical OR). Each element is an `InputQueryOptions` object and may itself contain nested `and`, `or`, or `not` logic.

not.description: All conditions must not match (logical NOT). Each element is an `InputQueryOptions` object and may itself contain nested `and`, `or`, or `not` logic.

propertyNames.description: Data points supported for filtering and sorting in screener queries. Retrieve valid values programmatically via `GET /direct-web-services/v1/screeners/equities/data-points`, or browse the full reference in the data dictionary.

InputDataPoints.title: InputDataPoints
InputDataPoints.description: Lists data points to return. Retrieve valid values programmatically via `GET /direct-web-services/v1/screeners/equities/data-points`, or browse the full reference in the data dictionary.

paginationTokenNext.description: Specifies the target of the next API call.

paginationTokenPrevious.description: Specifies the target of the next API call.

pageSize.description: Specifies the maximum number of results per page. The default value is 50.

InputSortOption.title: InputSortOption
InputSortOption.description: The data point and sort direction. The data point must correspond to a value passed in the `dataPoints` array.

InputFilterOptions.title: InputFilterOptions
InputFilterOptions.description: Supported operators for data point filtering.

InputFieldValueComparitorFilter.title: InputFieldValueComparitorFilter
InputFieldValueComparitorFilter.description: Filters for values within a range or based on a comparator condition. Supports numeric, integer, and date string data types.

InputFieldValueFilter.title: InputFieldValueFilter
InputFieldValueFilter.description: Filters for exact matches to value or a match to a value in a list. Supports string, number, integer, boolean, date and array data types.

InputFieldValueFilterFuzzy.title: InputFieldValueFilterFuzzy
InputFieldValueFilterFuzzy.description: Filters text string data type using fuzzy text matching.

fuzzy.description: Enable fuzzy text matching. Text string data types only.

name.description: Data points supported for filtering and sorting in screener queries. Retrieve valid values programmatically via `GET /direct-web-services/v1/screeners/equities/data-points`, or browse the full reference in the data dictionary.

x-enumDescriptions: date (Supports range operators, and equals and in queries. )
number (Supports range operators, and equals and in queries. )
string (Supports equals and in queries. Supports fuzzy searches for some data points.)

operators.description: Indicates the range and compound operators supported by the data point.

x-enumDescriptions: gte (Greater than or equal to. Numbers or dates.)
lte (Less than or equals. Supported by number and date data types.)
eq (Equals. Supported by boolean, date, number, and string data types.)

isSortable.description: When true, indicates that data point can be used to sort results.

isLanguageDependent.description: When true, indicates the data point is language-dependent.

isCurrencyDependent.description: When true, indicates the data point is currency-dependent.

OutputInvestment.title: OutputInvestment
OutputInvestment.description: Data points and corresponding values returned for each result. Keys are data point names in the format `<dataGroup>.<fieldName>`. Values may be string, number, integer, or boolean depending on the data point. Use the discovery endpoint to determine the type for each data point.

status.description: Provides information about an investment returned.
status.example: Data points are not entitled for 0P0001VK70 security.

dataPoints.description: Indicates the data points that could not be returned for the investment.

id.description: Indicates the investment for which no data was returned.

OutputScreenerMetadata.description: Metadata returned in response to requests to `POST /screeners/equities` endpoint. Includes information about data points not returned for results.
OutputScreenerMetadata.title: OutputScreenerMetadata

paginationTokenNext.description: Indicates token to fetch next page of results.

paginationTokenPrevious.description: Indicates token to fetch previous page of results.

totalCount.description: Indicates the total number of results found.

OutputDataPointsMetadata.description: Metadata returned in response to requests to `GET /screeners/equities/data-points` endpoint.
